message.content: {"caption":"A three-stage illustration shows reasoning agents progressing from human-supervised learning to self-play with less human supervision.","description":"A conceptual diagram is divided into three sections by vertical dashed lines. The left section, labelled “Supervised Learning,” shows a person beside a running brown robot. A thought bubble above the person contains a small red flag on a pole; a separate red flag on a pole stands to the robot’s right. The middle section, labelled “Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards,” shows a person pointing toward a running orange robot. A thought bubble above them contains a red flag on a pole, and another red flag on a pole stands to the robot’s right. The right section, labelled “Absolute Zero (Ours),” shows two orange robots: a smaller standing robot beneath a thought bubble containing a red flag on a pole, and a larger running robot beside a separate red flag on a pole. A broad grey arrow along the bottom points from left to right and is labelled “Less Human Supervision,” indicating decreasing human involvement across the three sections. There are no charted data or plotted values.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
